==========================================================
 Appearance:
 MR DAIFRAZ HAVEWALLA(3982) for the Applicant(s) No. 1  MS. MAITHILI MEHTA, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1  ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE M. R. MENGDEY  Date : 05/12/2025
ORAL ORDER 1.
By filing the present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioner has prayed for being shifted to a private hospital for his medical treatment.

The petitioner herein is arraigned as an accused in the FIR registered with D.C.B. Police Station, Surat City for the offences punishable under Section 420, 465, 467, 468, 471 of the Indian Penal Code.
The petitioner is presently admitted in the Civil Hospital, Surat and is in the I.C.U.
The petitioner is advised Angiography.

The facility for the same, is not available at Civil Hospital, Surat, and therefore, the petitioner is desirous for having his treatment at a private hospital situated at Surat, and therefore,
filed the present petition.
2. Heard learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner.
He submitted that at present the petitioner is admitted in the I.C.U. at Civil Hospital, Surat and his condition is critical.
The petitioner is aged about 85 years having body weight of around 150 kilograms.
The petitioner is advised Angiography by the Civil NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/16052/2025 ORDER DATED: 05/12/2025 undefined

sentences.text: Hospital, Surat, however, the facility for Angiography is not available at Civil Hospital, Surat, and therefore, the petitioner is advised to get the said procedure done at U.N. Mehta Institute of Cardiology, Ahmedabad.

entities.text: U.N. Mehta Institute of Cardiology, Ahmedabad
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: However, the distance between Surat and Ahmedabad is of around 200 kms and it may take around five hours to reach Ahmedabad from Surat.
The condition of the petitioner is such that he will not be able to undertake the travel from Surat to Ahmedabad.
The required facility is available at a private hospital situated at Surat viz. Mahavir Hospital where the petitioner wants to get himself treated.
He, therefore, submitted that the petitioner may be allowed to take treatment at Mahavir Hospital, Surat.
He, therefore, submitted to allow the petition.
3. Learned APP has opposed the present application.

4. Learned Advocate Mr. Niraj Buch appearing for the complainant has also opposed the petition contending that there appears to be a collusion between the petitioner and the doctor treating him at Civil Hospital, Surat.
The doctors at Civil Hospital, Surat initially advised him to be shifted to U.N. Mehta Institute of Cardiology, Ahmedabad.

entities.text: U.N. Mehta Institute of Cardiology, Ahmedabad
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: However, the said advise was thereafter scored of from the case papers.
He further submitted that the advise for shifting the petitioner to U.N. Mehta Institute of Cardiology, Ahmedabad had been given long back.

entities.text: U.N. Mehta Institute of Cardiology, Ahmedabad
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: However, the petitioner had consumed time in getting shifted.
He, therefore, submitted to dismiss the petition.
5. Heard learned Advocates for the respective parties.
This Court vide order dated 03.12.2025 had directed the learned APP to produce the medical papers of the petitioner from the concerned Jail.
Accordingly, the learned APP has produced the report of the present petitioner.
The report indicates that the condition of the petitioner is too critical and is advised Angiography on urgent basis.
However, the said facility is not available at Civil Hospital, Surat.
R/SCR.A/16052/2025 ORDER DA
6. Having regard to these facts, the petition deserves to be allowed.

The petitioner is ordered to be shifted to Mahavir Hospital, Surat for treatment with Police escort at the cost of the petitioner and the expenses for the treatment will also be bored by the petitioner.
